lokele: MUNGU oyaongaka la batata basu kwala mbile la mbile, ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya batɔndɔli la kanda la kanda ya boongeli,
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

lokele: asoonga lasu imɔ kwani nda bacho-ba ba liili ko la Wana, oyasosangesomo yaatotina ko la Mungu. Ko lande Mungu lokel’imɔ bitotina ebile nda wenda-bo.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

lokele: Ayalaka bongalikimi wa tala ya Mungu la boyaeli wa liluku eliengani chaa la elia Mungu; ayalaka Bosukamesi wa wenda bototina ko la Lioi liande lia bofoka. Asilak’Inde ndotanekes’iso batwanelo la bobe, Inde loyala se nda bosamba w’olome wa Oyaeti ako Mungu olikolo nda use,
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

lokele: ongoma asolongela bakitomo fɛɛ, eoka asosangola lina elisolongela baina bau fɛɛ.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

lokele: ¿Aongaka to la boni bokitomo la eni to mbile, mbo— Aɛ wende wana wami, Imi nd’asoot’Aɛ louse-lo? La liasi mbo— Itoyala nde Sango end’Inde, la Inde nd’atoyala wana ende’mi.
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” Psalms 2:7 and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?” 2 Samuel 7:14

lokele: La liasi imɔ, aeshelak’Inde wana wande wa oso ende balomboki nda wenda, Inde mbo— Bakitomo batotina ba Mungu basemolek’Inde.
english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.” Deuteronomy 32:43

lokele: Nde nda loasɔ loa bakitomo, Inde loonga mbo— Inde nd’asɛli fofo mbo bakitomo bande, La ndamɛ ya bosa mbo ebatolites’Inde.
english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.” Psalms 104:4

lokele: Nde nda loasɔ loa Wana, Inde loonga mbo— Ee Mungu, kɛka yaɛ elayalaka layalaya, Isosola sha isosha shaɛ, sile sha Bɔkɔta wande.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

lokele: Ososamaka liengani, nde osoiyela litefokoli lia bikela; Eokao Mungu, ako Mungu waɛ, asosiy’Aɛ la baita büch’Aɛ la limɛngɔ liolongela elia basaɔ baɛ.
english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.” Psalms 45:6-7

lokele: La imɔ— Aɛ, Ngɛnɛ, waswaka bisukamelo ya wenda nda baakoelo, Buse bole ngo ko likeli lia besamba yaɛ angɛnɛ;
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

lokele: Wao bolasɛɛsɛlɛkɛ, nde Aɛ bolatikalaka la lokato, Bilaulamaka kwa bisinda ebisowa baɔmbɔ.
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

lokele: Aɛ bolaundukolaka wao kwa esinda ya bɔsɔkɔ, La bilafangolomoko kwa shɛmɛsɛ; Nde Aɛ wende ngo ko ano, La miaka yaɛ bitilatungek’imɔ.
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.” Psalms 102:25-27

lokele: ¿Nde aongi to la boni bokitomo la eni mbile, mbo— Yalaka se nda fangi ya bosamba wami wa olome, Konda akateke Imi baiyani laɛ kwa esolo ya batindi baɛ?
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?” Psalms 110:1

lokele: ¿Bakitomo batotina baisoyalaka belimo ebitosemokola Munga la ebitomomu okasungaka loasɔ loa ebakasangoleke liuwesi?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

lokele: Eokao loengani nde lasu mbo toenyakeleke ndoenyakela ko yao ebisokak’iso, elua totacha kwa watɔ atocha mbole.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

lokele: Eoka eya mbo Lioi eliaongomoko lasu ko la bakitomo liyala nde wewe la eya nde wewe mbo njasɔ bitotina bisokuchakomo, kwa batwanelo kwa batefoli, ko la lokucho loengana,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

lokele: ani iso kokufa loao la moni, ani tosolenjalenja liuwesi lifi-li? Liuwesi-li liaongomoko la Ngɛnɛ oso la liakɔchɔmɔkɔ end’iso ko l’ebokaka Inde,
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

lokele: la Mungu angɛnɛ lokuliana lau ko la ndembe ya bisisho la tokesa twa kanda la kanda, la bakaɔ ebasokaela Bolimo Botanu kwa asosangak’Inde. Yesu Oyasotaliomo tala, asotang’iso balomboki mbo Bitungani
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

lokele: Eoka Mungu atiafaefaka bakitomo isosha shokakalesa bato ebatoyalaka nda wenda ebokayeke, ebokoongel’iso oko kwani.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

lokele: Nde asisa loonga nda lokasa lɔmɔi mbo— ¿Bolomboki end’iye mbo oenyakelek’inde, La wana wa oto mbo oniyek’inde sumbu?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

lokele: Osɔɔndɔl’inde ose ya bakitomo la mbile kɔni sumbu, Osowates’inde iyoyo sha tala la lilitesi;
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor. 2:7

lokele: Ososɛlɛ bitotina kakala ose ya batindi bande. Nde asɛlɛk’Inde bitotina kakala end’inde, litina lile mbo atiamachaka angɔmɔi eyetisɛlɔmɔ kakala end’inde. Kongo ko tokɛni kɔni bitotina ndosɛlɔmɔ kakala ende bolomboki;
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” Psalms 8:4-6 For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

lokele: nde tosotichak’Inde oyaɔndɔlɔmɔkɔ ose ya bakitomo ko la mbile sinyo, ako Yesu Oyasotaliomo tala la lilitesi lia yaatotina eoka ya bomusi wa liwa, mbo ko la booto wa Mungu aluweke bololo wa liwa loasɔ loa bato batotina.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

lokele: Loaenganaka to mbo Mungu, eoka bitotina lokelomo lande la ko l’eoka yande, l’ani asoesh’Inde bana wike ko nda tala, mbo aɔlɔlɛkɛ Botoli oso oyasoiyes’iyo nda liuwesi ko la bemusi finɛ.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

lokele: Eoka Oyasücha bato la bato ebasüchomo, batotina bende ngo ko la Sango ɔmwito; ko la litina-li, Yesu atioke sɔni yot’iyo lina liko bitungani.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers, 2:11

lokele: Inde mbo— Itotaka boeki wa lina liaɛ ende bitungani yami Nd’atiteni ya windi w’ebasosɔngɔmɔ itoinel’Aɛ la bɔɛlɛ.
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.” Psalms 22:22

lokele: La imɔ mbo— Imi nd’atolendelo Inde. La imɔ liasi, mbo— Imi-yo la bana ebasofaefa Mungu efaefa’mi.
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.” Isaiah 8:18

lokele: Ongoma, eoka ya mbo bana bende la bindo la bakila lisanga, ko ongoma asosɛlɛ imɔ ko yao, mbo ko la liwa liande, asɛɛsɛlɛk’inde oyayali la isosha sha liwa, ako Satana;
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

lokele: la mbo aɔnɔkɔlɛkɛ batotina ebaindomoko bɛkɔwa ko la liwawi liau litotina nda iwaesa sha liwa.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

lokele: Wewe atiunde bakitomo bosamba ndosungak’iyo, kangä bana ba Abalayama ebasosungomo lande.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring 2:16 of Abraham.

lokele: Eokao loaenganaka lande mbo akweke la liluku lia bitungani yande, mbo ayaleke Kanga Eyeti ya booto la eyolendelomo nda likuwa lia Mungu, litina mbo amɛsɛlɛkɛ batwanelo ba bato.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

lokele: Yesu asokɔkɔlɔ ndosungaka ebasokɔtɔlɔmɔ nda lisoshela, ko l’eoka mbo Inde angɛnɛ aokesomoko bemusi la asoshelomoko oso.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

lokele: Eokao to, Bitungani ebasüchomo, ino ebasotomo lioi elisosekwa nda use end’ino yaatotina, enyakelaka Botomomu la Kanga Eyeti oyasoaolelomo ko lasu, ako Yesu,
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

lokele: oyayalaka wolendelomo nda lotimbana end’Inde oyafaefak’Inde isosha, la Mose ko ongoma loyala la lotimbana nda likɔmɔnyi litotina lia ndakɔ ya Mungu.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

lokele: Eoka Yesu asofaefomo tala ya isosha ndolonga eya Mose, kwa boswi la bokomyi wa ndakɔ asofaefomo tala la lilitesi yolongela eya ndakɔ eyaswak’inde.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

lokele: Ndakɔ la ndakɔ esoswomo la boswi, nde oyaswaka la oyakomyaka yaatoti ale ngo ko Mungu.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

lokele: Mose ayalaka to la lotimbana lolendelomo nda likɔmɔnyi lia ndakɔ ya Mungu, kwa Bosungi mbo aluweseke njasɔ ebikaongomoko end’inde mbisa,
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

lokele: kongo ko Masiya ayalaka la lotimbana lolendelomu elole eloa Wana angɛnɛ nda ndakɔ ya Mungu. La iso nd’ayali bofindi wa ndakɔ yande, eya to mbo tokɔkɔmɛlɛ lotendela la bofiili nda iyomala sha iɛli shasu.
english: but Christ 3:6 is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

lokele: Eokao lole kwa asoonga Bolimo Botanu mbo— Louse-lo boka lioi liande,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

lokele: Okwelöko betema bewaü kwa akelaka batata la litefokoli; Nda lise lia likotelomu nda liɔmbɛlɛ,
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

lokele: Olo akotelaka batata banu okotela’mi, Limɔ iyo bɛnɛkɛ̈ tokesa etwakelaka’mi ko miaka kana inɛi.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

lokele: Eokao yasomaka la fɛtɔ ena, la imi loonga mbo— Basoeyaeyaka mbile bitotina nda betema yau, Batiluweke mboka yami.
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

lokele: Kwa atinyaka’mi ekanɔ nda lisomi liami, mbo— Batilaɔtɛk’imɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ bami.
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’” Psalms 95:7-11

lokele: Bitungani, tichaka, eluwa ɔmɔi wanu atayala la botema obe wotaka fee, la wosɛnyanes’ino la Mungu wa liwawi.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

lokele: Nde fumbesakanaka lise la lise, ani akotangomu buse mbo Louse, mbo boto angɔmɔi wanu atakwelo botema bowaü ko la bolimbake wa bobe.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

lokele: Eoka, eya to mbo tounda lilendelu ko ngwi konda liakoli konda liko, anyo iso kootwana la Masiya,
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

lokele: kwa asoongomo lioi mbo— Louse-lo boka lioi liande, Okwelöko betema bewaü kwa akelaka batata la litefokoli.
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.” Psalms 95:7-8

lokele: ¿Bandai to ebokaka lioi-li batefokolaka Mungu? ¿Batiayalaka nde batotina ebasokwaka nda Ejipeto ko la Mose?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

lokele: ¿Mungu asomaka nde la yandai ko miaka kama inɛi? Batiaaka ebakelaka obe la ebakwaka belyo se nda liɔmbɛlɛ?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

lokele: ¿Atinyaka nde ekanɔ ende bandai, mbo batilaɔtɛk’imɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ bande, sakolo ngo ko iyo ana ebatefolak’Inde?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

lokele: Eokao tosɔɛnɛ mbo batiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndɔɔtɔ ina eoka batiaaka la lilendelu.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

lokele: Eokao, kwa asotikomo lisakä liɔɔtɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ bande, towangeke mbo boto ɔmɔi wanu atatangomo mbo asoomelo bao.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

lokele: Eoka iso nd’asonangoelomo Mboli Ilau imɔ kwa iyo ana; kongo ko lioi eliokak’iyo litiaɔlɛsɛk’iyo yeka eoka litiasobianaka la lilendelu nda betema ya ebokaka liao.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

lokele: Kongo ko iso ebasoimela lisakä, tosɔɔtɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ, kwa aongak’Inde mbo— Kwa atinyaka’mi ekanɔ nda lisomi liami, mbo— Batilaɔtɛk’imɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ bami. Kongo ko tokesa twande twakelomoko konda lokelomo loa wenda-bo.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” Psalms 95:11 although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

lokele: Aongaka to olo nda lokasa, loasɔ loa lise lia osambale, mbo— Limɔ Mungu loɛuma la lise lia osambale nda bakuwa batotina ebakelak’Inde.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;” Genesis 2:2

lokele: Aongaka imɔ liasi mbo— Batilaɔtɛk’imɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ bami.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.” Psalms 95:11

lokele: Eokao losotikaelomo to bamɔi baɔtɛkɛ nda bao, limɔ ebanangoelomoko oso Mboli Ilau ina basoomelo ndɔɔtɔ eoka batiaaka la lilendelu,
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

lokele: nde Inde lotinya lisho liasi mbo Louse, ani aongak’Inde ko la Bɔɛlɛ wa Dawidi mbisa ya fɛtɔ wike, la baoi ebasoongomo oso, mbo— Louse-lo boka lioi liande, Okwelöko betema bewaü.
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.” Psalms 95:7-8

lokele: Eoka eya mbo Yoswa afak’iyo fofe yoɛuma ani atiaongak’imɔ loasɔ loa lise liasi mbisa;
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

lokele: baɛumɛlɔ ba Yenga basotikala oko ende bato ba Mungu,
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

lokele: eoka oyakaɔtɛkɛ nda baɛumɛlɔ bande, asoɛuma nda bakuwa ebande, kwa aɛumaka imɔ Mungu nda ebande bakuwa.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

lokele: Totafumbaka to ndɔɔtɔ nda baɛumɛlɔ bana, mbo boto atakwa nyongo ko la kanda ena ya litefoli.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

lokele: Eoka Lioi lia Mungu likoyali la liwawi l’itinjo, lowelo loa liao losolongela eloa ambɔtɛ ya fänga imbale, litotwɛlɛ ko nd’atiteni ya botema la bolimo, la ko nd’atiteni ya baonje la bɔɔngɔ wa tokwa, la litoataka baenyeli la basangi ba betema.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ yeka eyakelomoko lande eyetiɛnɛlɛ oso wa bɔmbɔ wande, eoka bitotina fɛɛ bile wase la bisotambomo fololo oso wa baiso ba Inde oyale Bokomyi wasu. Yesu Kanga-Eyeti ale kwa iso bato, nde angwɛnɛ litwanelo
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

lokele: Twende to la Kanga-Eyeti Efi oyasɔɔtɔ hɔu nda Use, ako Yesu Wana wa Mungu, eokao tokɔkɔmɛkɛ kɔkɛ nda liaolelomu liasu oaolel’Inde.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

lokele: Eoka toti la Kanga-Eyeti oyatikɔkɔlɛ ndokel’iso ngandi eoka ya biale yasu, nde Inde angɛnɛ asoshelomoko nda njasɔ bitotina kwa iso, nde angwɛnɛ litwanelo.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

lokele: Tosishaneke to la lotendela tina la kɛka yande ya booto, mbo tɔɔlɛkɛ shota la mbo tosheke booto bosungak’iso nda mbile ya boeno.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

lokele: Eoka kanga-eyeti oyasoaomo ende bato asofomo isosha shoongela bato nda njasɔ ya Mungu, mbo atambeke Mungu bafaefi la nyama yofechomo eoka ya batwanelo.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

lokele: Atokɔkɔlɔ ndowela eba botutuku ebale la batwanelo ngandi, eoka inde angɛnɛ asowa imɔ ko la biale.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

lokele: Ko la litina-li aondu nde ndotamba batambi loasɔ loande angɛnɛ imɔ ko loasɔ loa bato batotina.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

lokele: Nde boto aitotalema tala ko la isosha shande angɛnɛ nda likuwa-li, kangä ani asotomo lioi ko la Mungu, kwa atomoko ko Alana lioi.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

lokele: Ko ongoma, Masiya atiatalemaka Inde angɛnɛ tala yoyala Kanga-Eyeti, kangä Inde ataliaka Masiya oyaongaka mbo— Aɛ wende Wana wami, Imi nd’asoot’Aɛ louse-lo.
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.” Psalms 2:7

lokele: La nda bɔɛlɛ wasi mbo— Aɛ wende Kanga konda layalaya, ko la liluku lia Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ.
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.” Psalms 110:4

lokele: Ayalak’Inde ako Yesu la bindo ono, Inde losombola, Inde lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ la bileli finɛ la foo wike end’Inde oyasokɔkɔlɔ ndouwes’Inde nda liwa la Inde lolailomo ko eoka ya lilitesi ende Mungu.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

lokele: Ango aaka ngo Wana, nde Inde loeka lilitesi ko l’eoka mbo Inde looka bemusi,
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

lokele: limɔ aɔlɔlɔmɔkɔ Inde, Inde loya Ngɛnɛ wa liuwesi lia lokato ende ebatotina ebatolitekes’Inde,
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

lokele: l’ani asosingwomo ko la Mungu la lina liko Kanga-Eyeti ko la liluku lia Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

lokele: Tole la njasɔ wike yoonga loasɔ loande, njasɔ ebile biwau yosanoela litina eoka osoya la tolao nda batoi.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

lokele: Nde to wengani ko l’embile-ye ndoyala ngo baekesi, kongo ko wende la boeno wa boto woekes’ino liasi batina ba njasɔ ya lioi lia Mungu ko la liakoli, la wende la boeno wa baɛlɛ bomwa, inga kɔni bieka yotaunomo;
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

lokele: eoka oyatomwaka baɛlɛ ati la wɛlï woluwaka njasɔ ya liengani, eoka akoyali nde wana oli.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

lokele: Kongo ko bieka yotaunomo bile ya bato baoku ebasoekaka la ebasoluwa ndolembeela la bolau la obe.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

lokele: Totamachaka to njasɔ ya liakoli ebiomani nde la Masiya, la tɔkɛsɛnɛkɛ la oso nda yao ebisɔɔlwa, inga ndotak’imɔ liekesi lia likalangani loasɔ loa bekeeli ebisowa, la liimeli lia Mungu,
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

lokele: la liekesi lia lilufi, la lotalio loa besamba, la lɔtɛmwɔ nda liwa, la liataki lia njasɔ elia layalaya;
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

lokele: Mungu ɛlɛmbɛ, ani iso kokela ongoma.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

lokele: Eoka nda loasɔ loa ebasoeshomo nda löwa, ebasofomo bɔtɔ̈mɔ wa lifi lia Use la ebasokaana Bolimo Botanu la beoto,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

lokele: l’ebasoaela bɔtɔ̈mɔ wa lioi lilau lia Mungu la bofoka wa mbile eyekayeke,
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

lokele: limɔ basotaka njasɔ-bi se, angokɔkɔlɔ imɔ ndoinol’imɔ iyo liasi la likalangani, eoka anyo basoola Wana wa Mungu nda lieka ko liasi eoka yau angɛnɛ la basokes’Inde sɔni nda baiso ba bato.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

lokele: Nyɛlɛ ebisomwaka mbula ebisotɔnɔkɔ ina, la ebisɔtɛ̈kɛsɛ bieka yolesa bato ebasolɔɔ yao, nyɛlɛ ina bitɔɔlɔ lifotesi lia Mungu.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

lokele: Kongo ko eya mbo ɛɔtɛkɛsɛ ko kɛkɛ la toilaila, ani nyɛlɛ ina biti la litina, la bisambotutunyomo, tuu ya yao ko wambe.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

lokele: Ango toonga ngo ko ano, ino ebasamomu, tosoenyela wewe mbo njasɔ yolongela bina, bitoyel’ino, biko ebisoomana la liuwesi lianu.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

lokele: Eoka Mungu ale la liengani la aitolenja bakuwa banu la lisungi lia losamɔ elisotambak’ino, ko l’eoka ya lina liande, ende ebüchomu b’Etanda, la okosungak’iyo ko kwani.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

lokele: Tolɛmbi nde finɛ mbo boto la boto wanu atambeke bofiili-ao ko nd’akaiyelek’ino nda iɛli esitoundak’ino kɔkɛ ko nda liko,
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

lokele: mbo otayala la elemolomo, kangä bakweekeli ba iyo ebasosangola basakä ba Mungu ko la lilendelu la likɔkɔmɛlɛ.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

lokele: Eoka atikelaka Mungu Abalayama lisakä, Inde lotinya imɔ ko ekanɔ la lina liande angɛnɛ, eoka angwɛnɛ lina liasi liolongela eliande,
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

lokele: Inde mbo— Fufo, yefotesak’aɛ la yelaulwesaka bofindi waɛ.
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.” Genesis 22:17

lokele: Ongoma inde lɔɔlɔ to lisakä ko la likɔkɔmɛlɛ liande.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

lokele: Bato angɛnɛ batotinyaka bikanɔ ko la lina lia Inde oyalongel’iyo, la nda tofenya twau tototina ekanɔ etosilesa loasɔ.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

lokele: Ko ongoma, alɛmbɛkɛ Mungu ndotamba finɛfinɛ basangoli ba lisakä lina mbo kuko yande angokikwakikwa, Inde lowacha imɔ ekanɔ la lisakä liande,
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

lokele: mbo ko la njasɔ bimbale-bi ebitilakikwek’imɔ la ebitilatombolomoko la Mungu, iso balomboki ebasokwela Mungu botili, tosɔɛnɛ lisungi lia bofoka, mbo tokusameleke iɛli esisoeteel’iso oso.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

lokele: Iɛli-si sile end’iso kwa tondo ya bolimo eyeitosɔngwa la eyesoswomo se suu la eyesɔɔtɔ nda kuku ombisa ya Eüchelo,
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

lokele: olo asoeteel’iso Botoli oso wasu ako Yesu, Oyasoyala Kanga-Eyeti ko l’eoka yasu, layalaya la liluku lia Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

lokele: Oyoto’yo, ako Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ, bɔkɔta wa Salema, kanga ya Mungu Oyalongeli, atowanakä la Abalayama, ani ainwak’inde nda liömä lia bɛkɔta la inde loonga lande liölo lia lifotesi;
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

lokele: la Abalayama lokael’inde likaɔ limɔi nda liu lia findaka eyaindak’iyo. Ayalaka oso Bɔkɔta wa Liengani, lina liande lisosanolomo ongoma, limɔ ale imɔ Bɔkɔta wa Salema, litina mbo— Bɔkɔta wa Liɔngɛsi.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

lokele: La sango la nyango wande, la bangau la batata, la baotelo la bawelo bande angoluwana, nde ayalak’inde la bɔfɔnɔ wa Wana wa Mungu, asotikala kanga konda loiko.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo lokuku loa likama loa oto’yo! Ngau wasu wa oso, ako Abalayama angɛnɛ, lofaefak’inde likaɔ lia liu lia ngwoko ya findaka eyaindomoko.
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

lokele: La bana ba Lewi imɔ ebasɔɔsɔ isosha sha kanga basotelomo ndola yosɔnjaka bakaɔ ba liu ende bato; batɔɔsɔkɔ bao ko ende bitungani yau ebale imɔ ko bana ba ngau ako Abalayama.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

lokele: Nde oyatiaaka wana wa ngau yau nd’afomoko bakaɔ ana ko la Abalayama, la inde loongel’inde liölo lia lifotesi ani Abalayama nd’aaka ngɛnɛ wa basakä ba Mungu.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

lokele: Lioi-li litikɔkɔlɛ ndofinyomo la wee, liko mbo— Oy’ɔkɛkɛ nd’atofotesomo ko la oy’ofi.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

lokele: Ono kwani, ende balomboki ebatowaka ebatɔɔlɔ bakaɔ ba liu, nde omolo nda mbile ena, oyaɔlɔkɔ atangomoko mbo boto wa liwawi lia loiko.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

lokele: Ele kwa ndoonga mbo Lewi angɛnɛ, oyaɔlɔkɔ bakaɔ, inde nd’akusolaka bao oso ko la Abalayama,
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

lokele: eoka ayalaka ko nda bindo ya ngau wande eyatowanaka Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ la Abalayama.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo likɔmɔnyi lia bakanga ba Lewi liaɔlɔlɔkɔ bato nda baiso ba Mungu (eoka mbo bato bafomoko nde Bikela ko la liao), boni to boeno wa kanga yasi ya liluku lia Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ, tinga oyatangomoko kanga ya liluku lia Alona?
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

lokele: Eoka kanga befetekwanesomo, ambo Bikela kofetekwanesomo imɔ lisanga.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

lokele: Nde Inde oyasoongelomo njasɔ-bi aaka wa tukela yasi, eyetiaaka la boto wokuwela etambelo nda ndakɔ ya Mungu.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

lokele: Losoluwana fololo mbo Ngɛnɛ wasu atɛmwaka nda Yuda la Mose atiaongaka lioi ango limɔi loasɔ loa isosha sha kanga nda tukela ena.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

lokele: Loasɔ-lo losoluwana fololo, nde simbi to mbo kanga yasi asotɛmwa ko la bɔfɔnɔ wa Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ,
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

lokele: oyatiafomoko isosha sha kanga ko la ndola ya Bikela ya balomboki, kangä ko la bofoka wa loiko elotilaɔlɔkɔ imɔ.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

lokele: Eoka losoongelomo’inde mbo— Aɛ wende Kanga konda layalaya, ko la liluku lia Mɛlɛkisɛdɛkɛ.
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.” Psalms 110:4

lokele: Nde ekela ya oso esofangolomo eoka yaaka la bɔlɛmbu la liyaela lifi
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

lokele: eoka ekela etiaɔlɔlɔkɔ yeka; kongo ko iɛli esholongela sisoeshomo iso esitosishanes’iso tina la Mungu.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

lokele: La lotiaaka ongoma sakolo ko la ekanɔ—
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

lokele: eoka kwaala bafomoko isosha sha kanga l’angwɛnɛ ekanɔ, nde Oyo wa kwani ko la ekanɔ ya Inde oyaongelak’inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ Mungu atinyaka ekanɔ la atilakalanganek’imɔ, mbo Aɛ wende Kanga konda layalaya.
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’” Psalms 110:4

lokele: Ko l’ekanɔ-ye oyasoyala tuka ya Ngɛla yolongela, ale ko Yesu.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

lokele: Kanga ya kwaala yaaka nde wike, eoka liwa liakufesak’iyo ndoumwaka;
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

lokele: kongo ko Inde akotikala konda layalaya eoka aitoaekelana isosha sha Kanga.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

lokele: Eokao konda layalaya asokɔkɔlɔ ndouwesa ebatosishanaka la Mungu ko lande, ani atoyalaka’Inde la liwawi layalaya ko ndoongekel’iyo.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

lokele: Loondu nde lasu ndoyala la Kanga-Eyeti ya bɔfɔnɔ wande, la botanu, ati la bolimbake, ati la loasɔ, asosɛnyana la bato ba batwanelo la asotaliomo tala olikolo lia use.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

lokele: Ati ango la boeno botambaka lise la lise litambi loasɔ loa batwanelo bande angɛnɛ oso, limɔ loasɔ loa batwanelo ba bato kwa akelakaka Kanga-Ebieti ina; akelaka nde ano likela limwitoto ani atambaka Inde liwawi liande angɛnɛ.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

lokele: Eoka Bikela nd’afaka balomboki isosha shoyala kanga-bieti, kongo ko liölo lia ekanɔ eyayaka mbisa ya Bikela, lisoücha Wana Oyasɔɔlɔlɔmɔ konda layalaya.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

lokele: Litina elisoeta nda njasɔ ebisoongak’iso, lile mbo, tole la Kanga-Eyeti oyayali nde la bɔfɔnɔ-ao, oyakoyali se nda fangi ya osamba wa olome wa kɛka ya Oyalongeli nda Use;
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

lokele: Oyatokuwela Mungu nda Kumbo ya Etowanelo ya wewe eyaswomoko ko la Ngɛnɛ Mungu, inga la balomboki.
english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

lokele: Kanga-ebieti to basofomo isosha shotambaka bafaefi ba nyama yofechomo, eokao loengani nde imɔ la Kanga-Eyeti ye mbo ayaleke la yeka yotamba Mungu.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

lokele: Eya to mbo eyala ono nda wenda-bo ani atiyale kanga, eoka kanga bikoyala ndotambaka bafaefi kwa aongomu nda Bikela.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

lokele: Iyo nd’atokuwela ko bɔfɔnɔ la elimi ya Esemoelo nda use; kwa aluwesomokö Mose eyasamboswak’inde kumbo ya esemoelo, Mungu loonga mbo— Tatichaka mbo wakela bitotina kwa ayaliki ikweela esisotambomo aɛ nda löngo.
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.” Exodus 25:40

lokele: Nde kwani Yesu asɔɔlɔ isosha shokuwela Mungu esisolongela, imɔ ko mbo Inde nd’ayali Bokumi wa Ngɛla eyesolongela eya oso, la eyesokɔkɔmɛsɔmɔ ko la basakä bolongela.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

lokele: Eoka eya to mbo ngɛla ya oso etiaomeloko loasɔ, ani angolukak’imɔ fofe ya ngɛla yasi.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu oyasofak’iyo liɛngɔ eoka yao loomelo, Inde loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ Mungu asoonga mbo— Toka kɔni, bacho belayaka nde ebakatinyeke lami Ngɛla Eyai la bokulü wa Isalaɛlɛ l’eba Yuda;
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, 8:8 the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

lokele: Inga kwa yao eyatinyaka’mi la batata bau nda lise eliaundaka’mi iyo la osamba, Mbo isokolek’iyo nda yese ya Ejipeto; eoka batiaumwaka ndolitesa Ngɛla yami, Limɔ Imi lolemol’iyo; Ngɛnɛ Mungu loonga ewa.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngɛla eyelatinyaka’mi la bokulü wa Isalaɛlɛ mbisa ya bacho ana; Ngɛnɛ Mungu loonga ewa. Itota bikela yami nda baenyeli bau, la itosɔnɔ yao ko nda betema yau; Limɔ itoyalaka eyau Mungu la iyo batoyalaka ebami bana.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

lokele: Boto angoekekes’imɔ boyalani lande; Ango boto angoongana la etungani yande mbo— Luwaka Ngɛnɛ! Eoka batotina batoluwaka’mi la wɛlï, kond’afi kond’akɛkɛ.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen 8:11 and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

lokele: Yelaokelak’iyo booto womɛsɛkɛlɛ iyo batongwi bau, La itilaenyelek’imɔ batwanelo bau.
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.” Jeremiah 31:31-34

lokele: Aongomoko lioi liko-Ngɛla Eyai, litina lile mbo atangaka eya oso kwa mbo esoulama la yeka eyesoulamaka ambo esokata la esambosɛɛselɛ.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

lokele: Ngɛla ya Oso yaaka nde la ndola ya lisemoli la Eüchelo nda wenda-bo.
english: Now indeed even the first 9:1 covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

lokele: Eoka kumbo yakomiomoko eya lousa, la nda litenya-li liaaka la etalielo ya päka, la mɛsa olo atambomoko batuma, litenya lina liatangomoko Eüchelo ya Botanu.
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

lokele: Limɔ ombisa ya esinda ya bolelo litenya liasi liatangomoko mbo Eüchelo ya Botanu Wolongela,
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

lokele: la liayalaka la litumbe lia efechelo ya tosandu twa liɛsɛ la kwokwolo yoisa ngɛla la isako eshasɛlɛkɛ Mana la yeka-bi bisatɔ yalinjomoko la yeto ya loketi fafo; la itumbe sha Alana eshaɔ̈tɔ̈kɔ batɔmbɔ, la batalɛ ba Ngɛla loyala imɔ ko nda kwokwolo;
english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

lokele: la olikolo lia kwokwolo Bakeluba bambale ba tala loinamaka bafafu bau likolo lia Eyaelo ya Booto wa Mungu. Toti kwani la mbile yoonga loasɔ loa yeka la yeka sumbu.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

lokele: Limɔ atonjomoko ebitotina-bi, kanga yaɔtɔkɔkɔ nda litenya lia lousa ndokakelaka likuwa lia lisemoli;
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

lokele: kongo ko Kanga-Eyeti kongo nd’aɔtɔkɔ nda litenya lia kuko eko Eüchelo ya Botanu Wolongela, ko liɔtɔ limwito nda mwaka la inde angɔɔtɔ sakolo ngo ko asotamba bakila eoka yande la eoka ya batwanelo ba bato.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

lokele: Ongoma Bolimo Botanu asoluwes’iso mbo mboka yɔɔtɔkɔ nda Eyaelo ya Botanu ɛkɛnɛli ani litenya lia oso likoyali,
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

lokele: yao ele ko ndembe ya ikweela ende eba mbile-ye, nda loasɔ-lo bafaefi la nyama yofechomo bisotambakomo nde bitikɔkɔlɛ ndɔɔlɔlɔkɔ baenyeli ba betema ya ebatosemola Mungu.
english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

lokele: Nde bina bile ko l’eoka ya bieka yola la yomwa la basooli ba kanda la kanda; bile ko ndola ya bindo ebisotomo konda mbile ya lienganesi lia yao.
english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

lokele: Nde ayaka Masiya ndoyayala Kanga-Eyeti ya ebilau ebikayeke, Inde lɔɔtɔ ko la litenya lia Eüchelo ya Botanu eyesolongela la eyesɔɔlwa, eyetikelomo la besamba la eyeti ya balomboki kongo,
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

lokele: Inde lɔɔtɔ to nda Eüchelo ya Botanu Bolongela, inga to la bakila ba mbuli angoko ba bifembeli ya mbolo, kanga la bakila bande angɛnɛ, la ongoma Inde loosha liendolomu liasu lia layalaya.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

lokele: Eya to mbo bakila ba mbuli la mbolo la biuta ya mbolo itomali ebisomɛmyakomo, betanekesa ko bindo ya bato ebasokwaka bekila,
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

lokele: nde simbi to bakila ba Masiya kotanekesa baenyelo ba betema yanu ebisoowana la bekeeli ya liwa mbo bokuweleke Mungu wa Loiko. Ko la Bolimo wa layalaya Inde angɛnɛ lotamba Mungu botema wande ebotiaaka la loasɔ ango lɔmɔi.
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

lokele: Masiya ale to Bokumi wa Ngɛla Eyai ko la litina-li, mbo ebasotomo lioi baɔlɛkɛ botiko wa layalaya ewatikelomoko iyo lisakä, eoka liwa lina lisoesha liendolomu lia batɔngwi nda ngɛla ya oso.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

lokele: Nda loasɔ loa lokasa loa botiko, loti ango l’isosha sakolo ko liwa lia ngɛnɛ wa loao lisotaluwana la wewe.
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

lokele: Botiko bososangolomo ko la liwa lia ngɛnɛ wa wao, boitosangolomo ani ngɛnɛ akoyali la liwawi.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

lokele: Ko ano to Ngɛla ya oso etiatinyomoko sakolo ngo ko la bakila;
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

lokele: eoka asilaka Mose ndokambesa bato batotina ndola bitotina ya Bikela, inde lɔɔsɔ bakila ba bifembeli ya mbolo l’eba mbuli amamwito la balia la fuu ya bɛkɔkɔ ebisotomo langi bitelu la bafifa, inde lomɛmyaka bao nda Lokasa loa ngɛla la ende bato batotina,
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

lokele: inde loonga mbo— Eba bende bakila ba ngɛla eyateelaka Mungu ino.
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.” Exodus 24:8

lokele: Limɔ inde lomɛmyaka bakila ko ongoma nda Kumbo eyüchomu la nda biengo bitotina yosemoela Mungu.
english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

lokele: Ko la likomyi lia Bikela, tina la biengo bitotina bisosaesomo ko la bakila, etiye to la lisɛndwi lia bakila, ani angwɛnɛ limɛsɛli.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

lokele: Eokao loaenganaka mbo tokweelo twa tutakela ya yeka ya Use bitanesomoko ko la yeka-bi nde yeka angɛnɛ ya Use kotanesomo ko la batambi bolongela bina.
english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

lokele: Eoka Masiya atiɔtɛkɛ nda Eüchelo ya Botanu eyaswomoko ko la besamba ya bato, eyele ko ikweela sha eya wewe, nde Inde lɔɔtɔ nda Use angɛnɛ okɛnɛlɛ omao oso wa baiso ba Mungu eoka yasu.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

lokele: Atiaɔtɔkɔ ko ndotambak’Inde angɛnɛ batamba wike kwa aɔtɔkɔkɔ Kanga-Eyeti mwaka la mwaka la bakila ebatiaaka ebande angɛnɛ;
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

lokele: ani awaka to tokange bawa wike konda bakeelo ba wenda konda eweuse. Nde kwani asɔɛnɛlɛ ko liɛnɛlɛ limwitoto nda basilelo ba mbile mbo asɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ batwanelo fɛɛ ko la litambi lia botema wande angɛnɛ.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

lokele: Balomboki baondu nde ndowa liwa limwito, la mbisa yaamao oko liati lia njasɔ kongo;
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

lokele: ko ongoma asotambomo Masiya lotambo ko lɔmɔi mbo atoleke batwanelo ba bato wike, limɔ elaɛnɛlɛkɛ liasi ende ebatolombakel’Inde, inga imɔ la batwanelo, kangä loasɔ loa liuwesi liau.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

lokele: Bikela yende ko elimi ya ambɔlɛ wa bolau ebolayeke, biti to ikweelo angɛnɛ sha yao ebiyali nde wewe, eokao ko l’eoka ya batambi ebatotambakomo mwaka la mwaka, bitikɔkɔlɛ ndɔɔlɔlɔkɔ ebatosishakana tina la yao.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

lokele: Aenaka ongoma, ani batambi baisomacha ndotambokomo, eoka betema ya basemokoli betanesomoko, ani iyo koluwa wewe mbo bende la batwanelo?
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

lokele: Kongo ko, batambi bana batoenyakelesa bato batwanelo bau mwaka la mwaka;
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

lokele: eoka bakila ba mbolo l’eba mbuli batikɔkɔlɛ ndosokola batwanelo basu.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

lokele: Eokao, aiyelak’Inde wenda-bo, Inde loonga mbo— Otilɛmbɛ batambi bofechomo la bafaefi ba bieka, Ende ngo bindo eyesotonj’Aɛ eoka yami;
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

lokele: Otiomale nda batambi ba nyama yofechomo, La bafaefi eoka ya batwanelo basu.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

lokele: Limɔ, Imi loonga to mbo— Tɛnɛngo, Imi nd’asoya oyakela lisangi liaɛ, Ee Mungu; Loasɔnɔmɔkɔ ongoma nda botüku wa Lokasa eoka yami.
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’” Psalms 40:6-8

lokele: Aongaka oso mbo— Batambi bofechomo la bafaefi ba bieka la batambi ba nyama yofechomo la bafaefi eoka ya batwanelo, otilɛmbɛ bao la otiomale nda bao, (ani batambomoko kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Bikela)
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

lokele: limɔ Inde loonga mbo— Tɛnɛngo, Imi nd’asoya oyakela lisangi liaɛ. Asotombola eloa oso mbo akɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ eloa mbisa.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

lokele: Ko la lisangi lina tosotanekesomo ko la litambi limwitoto lia bindo ya Yesu Masiya.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

lokele: La kanga bitotina bitoemakala lise la lise ndokelaka lotimbana lotambaka batambi liasi la liasi ko litambi lia bɔfɔnɔ-ao, la bao batikɔkɔlɛ imɔ ndosokola batwanelo basu;
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

lokele: kongo ko atambak’Inde ako Masiya litambi ko limwito eoka ya batwanelo, limɔ Inde loyala se ko nda liko nda bosamba wa olome wa Mungu,
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

lokele: limɔ atoumbakela ko nd’akasɛlɔmɔkɔ biyani lande kwa esolo ya batindi bande,
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

lokele: eoka ano ko la litambi limwito, asɔɔlɔlɔkɔ ebasüchomo, konda layalaya.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

lokele: La tole imɔ la likuliomu lia Bolimo Botanu, oyasotaonga mbo—
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngɛla eyelatinyaka’mi lau mbisa ya bacho ana, Ngɛnɛ Mungu loonga ongoma; Itota bikela yami nda betema yau, La itosɔnɔ yao ko nda baenyeli bau.
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” Jeremiah 31:33 then he says,

lokele: La batwanelo bau la batongwi bau, itilaenyeleke imɔ bao.
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.” Jeremiah 31:34

lokele: Ongoma to asomɛsɔlɔmɔ batwanelo, ani angwɛnɛ imɔ litambi eoka ya batwanelo.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

lokele: Bitungani, kwa ayali iso la lotendela ndɔɔtɔ nda Eüchelo ya Botanu, ko l’eoka ya bakila ba Yesu,
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

lokele: eyele mboka eyai, l’eya loiko, eyalioelak’Inde olioel’iso ko la esinda ya bolelo, eko bindo yande,
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

lokele: la eoka mbo twende la Kanga-Eyeti Oyalongeli ndokɔmɔnya bofindi wa Mungu,
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

lokele: tosishaneke to tina lande la botema wa momongo la lilendelu lifi, ani betema yasu bisomɛmyakomo loasɔ loa limɛsɛli lia obe, la bindo yasu bisosoolomo la balia batanu.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

lokele: Tokɔkɔmɛkɛ to kɔkɛ nda liaoleli lia iɛli shasu, angomelaimela, eoka oyatikelak’iso lisakä ale wolendelomu.
english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

lokele: Toenyakeleke ndofumbesana nda njasɔ ya losamɔ la bekeeli bilau,
english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

lokele: angolenja ndosɔngɔkɔmɔ, kwa atokelaka bamɔi, kangä kofumbesana, simbi to ani asɔɛn’ino mbo Lise lina lia Ngɛnɛ lisoya tina.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

lokele: Nde tokela obe ngo ko la yɛnɔ ani tososila ndoluwesomo mboka ya wewe, ano angotikal’imɔ litambi loasɔ loa batwanelo basu, kangä ko iwaesa sha baatelo ba njasɔ yasu la efango ya lofio eyetoombesa biyani lande hombe.
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

lokele: Boto oyatotefola Bikela ya Mose, inde kowa angwɛnɛ liwa ngandi, ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya bato bambale ango basatɔ ebɛnɛkɛ loasɔ.
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

lokele: Asa kɔni boto oyasotefwesa Wana wa Mungu la oyasotanga bakila ba ngɛla mbo bɔwɛwɛ ani basotanes’inde, la oyasotefwesa bɔmbɔ wa Bolimo wa Booto; ¿Otangi nde mbo boto-yo engani nde eni kanda ya likuchi lifi to?
english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

lokele: Eoka toisoluw’Inde oyaongaka mbo— Likundeli lile loasɔ loami, Imi nd’atosakanesa njasɔ. La mbo— Ngɛnɛ nd’atoyala wataki wa bato bande.
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Deuteronomy 32:35 Again, “The Lord will judge his people.” Deuteronomy 32:36

lokele: Iwaesa sina, siko ndokwa se nda besamba ya Mungu wa Lokato! Toenyakeleke bifembi ya kwaala
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

lokele: Enyakelaka to mbile ya kwala eyaeshomoko ino nda löwa loa liuwesi ani aumwak’ino ndonana la bifembi liangɔ;
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

lokele: mbile bimɔi watambomoko bɔkɛcha la bifembi finɛ nda baiso ba bato la mbile bimɔi wawatemaka la baina ebakelakomoko ongoma.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

lokele: Eoka wawelak’imɔ eba bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ngandi la wasaekelaka betema la limɛngɔ eyaindomoko biengo yanu eoka waluwaka mbo ino angɛnɛ wende la biengo yolongela ebilayaleke lanu ko layalaya.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

lokele: Omachëke to lilendelu lianu elile la bondanda wa likama ebokɔɔlɛk’ino.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

lokele: Nde ende la boeno wa likɔkɔmɛlɛ mbo akakelek’ino lisangi lia Mungu bɔɔlɛkɛ ko yao eyatikomoko lisakä.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

lokele: Eoka ko mbile sinyo sinyo, Limɔ oyakayeke, Inde eyaka nde la aitomɔngɔmɔngɔ.
english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

lokele: Nde boto wami wa liengani eikaka ko la lilendelu, kongo ko einywa bituki mbisa, Ani botema wami angoomala loasɔ loande.
english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.” Habakkuk 2:3-4

lokele: Nde iso toitoinywa bituki mbisa ndokakwa nda lɔsɛɛsɛlɔ, kangä mbo twende bato ba lilendelu kond’akaɔlɛk’iso betema yasu la liuwesi.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

lokele: Lilendelu lile to liluwi lioimela njasɔ ebikokɛsɛkɛl’iso toɛli, la lile liaesi se lia njasɔ ebikɛnɛli kɔni end’iso.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

lokele: Eoka ko la liao bangau bakuliomoko la lokuku lolau.
english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu tosoluwa mbo yaatotina yakelomoko ko la lioi lia Mungu, mbo yao ebisɔɛnɛlɛ bitiakelomoko ko la yao ebisɔɛn’iso la baiso.
english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu, Abele lotambela Mungu litambi elialongaka elia Kaina, ani atangomoko mbo boto wa liengani ko la Mungu oyaaelaka bafaefi bande; ongoma ko l’eoka ya lilendelu, oyawaka akoonga.
english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu Anoka ilomoko nda Use mbo atɛnɛ liwa; litiaoshak’inde eoka Mungu nd’ailak’inde. Eoka ani akilomo nda Use aongelomoko mbo boto oyaomalesaka Mungu,
english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

lokele: la aenaka lilendelu boto angokɔkɔlɔ ndoomales’Inde. Eoka loengani la boto oyatoya ende Mungu mbo aimeleke mbo ayali, la mbo atɔɔlɛs’iyo bondanda, bako ebatolukak’Inde.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu Noa oyataluwesomoko loasɔ loa ebikɛnɛlɛkɛ, inde lolitesa Mungu, la inde loswa watɔ kwa ndakɔ eoka ndouwesa bofindi wande; ko ongoma inde lofa eba wenda se, la inde ako Noa losangola botiko wa liengani elitosangolomo ko l’eoka ya lilendelu.
english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, 11:7 prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu Abalayama, ani atomoko lioi, inde losekwa ko la lilitesi okakɛ nda elela eyekaɔlɛk’inde kwa botiko la inde losekwa ani atialuwaka olo atɔkɛ lande.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu inde lolimela nda yese eyatikelomoko inde lisakä, kwa bɔɛnda, la inde loyalaka nda kumbo la Isaka la Yakobo ebasanganaka lande nda lisangoli lia lisakä.
english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

lokele: Eoka inde loluka bokenge ebotoswomo suu nda lionda, Bosweeli la Bɔfɔɔli ngo Mungu angɛnɛ.
english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu Sala ani atiaak’imɔ wali woota, ambo inde aɔlɔkɔ bofoka woaelo lieme, eoka inde lotang’Inde wolendelomo oyatelak’inde lisakä, ako Mungu.
english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

lokele: Ongoma to boto ɔmɔi oyaaka ngo kwa bolyo loota bato wikewike kwa bokamu wa tolonge twa use la kwa boke nda ngɔngɛ ya liyande angotangomo loketi.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

lokele: E-batotina-ba bawaka ngo ko la lilendelu ani bakakɔchɛlɔmu lisakä, nde iyo lɔɛnɛ liao kwa ilimele sha okenge iyo loinela liao, l’ani iyo loaolaka mbo baaka bɛɛnda la bakɛndi nda wenda-bo;
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen 11:13 them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

lokele: nde bato ebatoonga ani, batoluwesa basi fololo mbo basokalukake yese yasi yolimela ina.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

lokele: Eya to mbo baenyakelaka yese ena olo asekwak’iyo, ani bɛnɛkɛ fofe yoinywa omao.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

lokele: Kongo ko balɛmbɛkɛ finɛ ko yese yolongela, eko eya Use; eokao Mungu atiaokaka sɔni ndotangokomo Mungu wau, eoka Inde lotatonjel’iyo bokenge.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu, akɔtɔlɔmɔkɔ Abalayama, inde lotamba Isaka kwa litambi liofechomo ani atikelomoko lisakä, inde lotamba wana ɔmwitoto wande;
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born 11:17 son,

lokele: ako inde oyaongelomoko mbo— Ko la Isaka bana batotangomo ebaɛ;
english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,” Genesis 21:12

lokele: eoka inde lotanga mbo Mungu atokɔkɔlɔ ndotɛmɔlɔ ango ebasowa la ainolomoko wana wande kwa mbo asouwa nda liwa.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu Isaka loonga baoi ba lifotesi ende Yakobo la Esau nda njasɔ ebikayeke.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu, Yakobo ani aaka inde tina lowa, inde loonga baoi ba lifotesi ende ɔmɔi la ɔmɔi wa bana ba Yosefa limɔ inde lotulama likolo lia itumbe shande nda lisomboli.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu, Yosefa ani atungamak’inde, inde loenyela loasɔ loa liunjwi lia bana ba Isalaɛlɛ la inde lotel’iyo ndola eoka ya bolyo wande.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu, Mose loisomo ko tengai isatɔ ko l’ebaotak’inde, eoka iyo lɔɛnɛ mbo aaka wana wa litutuku la batiawangaka liti lia bɔkɔta wa Ejipeto.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu, akondaka Mose otowange, inde lofekaka ndotangomo Wana wa boseka wa Falao,
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

lokele: nde inde loɛtɛmɛlɛ ndokongolomo amamwito la bato ba Mungu, inga to bamɛngɔ ba batwanelo ebatoumwa ko mbile sinyo.
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

lokele: Atangaka mbo sɔni kwa eya Masiya kolongela lifoka lia likama lia yese ya Ejipeto, eoka inde lololaka bondanda ebokaɔlɛk’inde.
english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu inde losekwa nda Ejipeto, inga eoka ya bɔwa ndowanga efango ya bɔkɔta, kangä mbo akɔkɔmɔkɔ ko ndowɛlɛ Oyaitɔɛnɛlɛ baiso.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu inde lokela Elambɔ ya Lieti la inde lomɛmyaka bakila mbo Boombesi wa bana ebaotomu oso atamata ango iyo.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu bana ba Isalɛlɛ loleka Eliya ya Balia Batelu kwa mbo boili, nde akotaka eba Ejipeto okela ongoma, iyo lolinda mbi.
english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu bakula ba bokenge wa Yeliko lowɛlɛmɛ se ani balingelomoko ko bacho osambale.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

lokele: Ko la lilendelu Lahaba, botomali wa bolëfë, atiasɛɛsɛlɛkɛ amamwito l’eba litefokoli, eoka inde lonyangela totombi la booto.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

lokele: ¿Iongeke to bini njasɔ imɔ? Eoka mbile bitoomelo’mi ndotangela njasɔ ya Gideona, l’eya Balaka, l’eya Samisona, l’eya Yɛfɛta, l’eya Dawidi, l’eya Samwele, l’eya bɛtɔndɔli;
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

lokele: mbo ko la lilendelu, e-bato-ba bakakalesaka bɛkɔta, iyo bakomiaka njasɔ la liengani, iyo baɔlɔkɔ basakä, bakandaka bɛnɔkɔ ya simba,
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, Daniel 6:22-23

lokele: batiamesaka bolengi wa bösä, balɔmwaka fänga ya chaka, baɔlɔkɔ bofoka ani bawaka boleka, bakweloko bewangɔ ya bita, baunaka bikuke ya biyani ya yese yasi.
english: quenched the power of fire, Daniel 3:1-30 escaped the edge of the sword, 1 Kings 19:1-3 from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

lokele: Batomali banyangelaka bato bau ebawaka, ko la litɛmwi; bamɔi baunakomoko tokwa tototina nde bafekaka ofaikolomo mbo baosheke lotɛmɔlɔmɔ eloeta.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. 1 Kings 17:17-23 Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

lokele: Bamɔi bakotelomoko ko la lomuchamucho la likuchaki lia tososola, batomoko bakala la bɛnyɔlɔlɔ;
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

lokele: Baolomoko ko la fëngu ya batalɛ, batenomoko yaki la besumani, baolomoko la angɔngɔnɔ, bakɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ ani bawati kofo ya bɛkɔkɔ l’eya mbuli, la boeno bofi, nda bifembi biwau, bakelakomoko bobe finɛ.
english: They were stoned. 2 Chronicles 24:20-21 They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. Jeremiah 26:20-23 They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

lokele: bato ba wenda batiaondoko oyalana lau; baeyaeyaka nda baɔmbɛlɛ la nda föngo, la nda basɛkɔ la fowa ya nyɛlɛ.
english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

lokele: La ango batotina-ba baluwanaka la lokuku lolau ko l’eoka ya lilendelu liau, kongo ko batitaɔlɔkɔ kɔni lisakä,
english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

lokele: eoka Mungu nd’asotüchel’iso loasɔ lolongela l’olau, mbo bataɔlɔlɔmɔ ko iyo, kangä iso lau lisanga.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

lokele: Eokao, asolingakelomo iso ongoma la ekuke efi ya ebasoaolela lilendelu liolendela Yesu, toteke belito bitotina se imɔ ko la bobe ebosowatema la bakolo basu, tokweke mangu la winikɔlɔ nda fɔmbi eyesokomielomo iso;
english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

lokele: tokwɛlɛkɛ ngo Yesu bonono oyale Botoli oso la Oyatɔɔlɔlɔ imɔ lilendelu liasu, oyatendelaka liwa lia lieka ko l’eoka ya bootaota ewüchelomoko Inde, oyaolyaka sɔni ya lieka, Inde asoyala se nda bosamba wa olome wa kɛka ya Mungu.
english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

lokele: Enyakelak’Inde oyatendekelaka tofenya tobe twa bato ba batwanelo mbo ino angɛnɛ otaoka itɔɔ la mbo otalewa nda betema yanu.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

lokele: Nda bita ebisonanak’ino la obe, bafumba banu bakasɛndɔli bakila banu.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

lokele: Oisoosala baoi ebaongomoko lanu kwa atoimomo bana angɛnɛ? Wana wami, oolyëke liekesi lia Ngɛnɛ Mungu, Olewëke ani atoimakomo aɛ ko lande;
english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

lokele: Eoka Ngɛnɛ Mungu atoekekesa la likuchi wana ona oyatosam’Inde, Atokuchaka imɔ bana ebatotangomo ebande.
english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.” Proverbs 3:11-12

lokele: Tendekelaka to eoka ya likuchi, ko ongoma Mungu asokeel’ino kwa mbo wende bana bande. ¿Oni to wana atikomyomo la sango wande?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

lokele: Eya mbo otikomyomo kwa atokomyomo bana batotina, ambo ot’imɔ bana wewe, kangä eba nyongo.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

lokele: Loasɔ loasi imɔ, iso balomboki twende la basango bokomya iso, tosolitekes’iyo, nde simbi to iso kokakalesomo la Sango wa belimo la mbo toyaleke la loiko, eti wa?
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

lokele: Basango basu nd’atokuchak’iso ko mbile sinyo kongo, kwa atosang’iyo, nde Mungu nd’atokomya iso mbo toenganeke olau la mbo toyaleke batanu kwa ayali imɔ ko Inde.
english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

lokele: Nda mbile ya lokomyo, lole ngo ko la bomusi, loti la limɛngɔ, nde mbisa ebasoekesomo la loao, batɔɔlɔ bondanda wa lilatemi, boko liengani.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

lokele: Eokao, ilaka besamba yanu ebisolɛmbɛlɛmbɛ la wangekemesa balui banu ebasotatema,
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees, Isaiah 35:3

lokele: longamesaka mboka ya batindi banu ko fii, mbo eba bikoti batafelengwana, kangä mbo basäsolomoko.
english: and make straight paths for your feet, Proverbs 4:26 so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

lokele: Kotaka ndoyalana la lilatemi, ino la basi batotina, la botanu imɔ; otiyale la wao ani otilɛnɛkɛ Mungu, boto angɔmɔi.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

lokele: Tɛnɛkɛ la wɛli mbo boto angɔmɔi wanu ataomelo booto wa Mungu, la mbo litina lia bololo litaɔ̈tɔ̈ nda betema yanu ndof’ino liwesani, l’ani batotina kobebesomo;
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

lokele: la wɛli imɔ mbo boto angɔmɔi atakwelo bolëfë, angoko itomwela kwa ayalaka imɔ Esau oyaungesaka lisakä lia botiko ebokɔɔlɛk’inde, ko la bieka ya lila limwito.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

lokele: Oluwi nde mbo, mbisa ani alɛmbɛk’inde fofe yosangola lisakä lia lifotesi, inde lofekelomo, eoka atiɛnɛkɛ fofe yokalangana, ango kwa alukak’inde yao la foo imɔ.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

lokele: Nde otisishaneke tina la yeka yomatelomo la besamba, eko bösä wa loiloi, la boutuutu la lilima lia ndi la lomba lofi,
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

lokele: angoko losongo loa ifonge la limiki lia baölo, la ebokaka liao loombaka mbo bataongelomo lioi liasi imɔ,
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

lokele: eoka batiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndotendela liti eliatomoko mbo— Eya ngo nyama komata löngo, yao koolomo ko la batalɛ.
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”. 12:20 Exodus 19:12-13

lokele: La eoka mbo wɛnɛɛli ona walongaka l’iwaesa, Mose loonga mbo— Isowa bɔwa, isoilima to!
english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.” Deuteronomy 9:19

lokele: Nde ososishana tina la Löngo loko Siona, ngima ya Mungu wa Loiko eko Yelusaleme ya Use, la ende litunda lia likama lia Bakitomo ebasosɔngɔkɔmɔ nda basemoelo,
english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

lokele: la ende Etanda y’ebaotomoko ko oso ebasotomo baina nda Use, la ende Mungu Wataki wa yaatotina, la ende belimo ya bato ba liengani ebasɔɔlɔlɔkɔ hɔlɔɔ,
english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

lokele: la ende Yesu Bokumi wa Ngɛla Eyai, la imɔ nda bakila ebamɛmyɔmɔkɔ ebatoonga njasɔ bilau yolongela eya bakila ba Abela.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, Jeremiah 31:31 and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

lokele: Tɛnɛkɛ la wɛlï mbo otatefokol’Inde oyasoonga; eya to mbo iyo ana batiakufaka likuchi eoka batefokolak’inde oyaimak’iyo ono nda wenda-bo, nde asa kɔni iso ebasotefwes’Inde omolo nda Use oyasoimak’iso.
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

lokele: Limɔ limiki liande liatukatukesa nyɛlɛ, nde kwani asotika lisakä mbo— Ko liasi imɔ itotukatukesa litukesa limɔi, inga ko nyɛlɛ kongo, kangä imɔ ko use lisanga.
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.” Haggai 2:6

lokele: Lioi-li liko mbo— Liasi limɔi, lile la litina mbo losokolomo loa yao ebisolɛlɛlɛsɔmɔ, biko yao ebisokelomo kongo, mbo yao ebitilɛlɛlɛsɔmɔ bitikaleke.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

lokele: Eokao, asoaelak’iso Yakakaelo ya Bɔkɔta wasu eyetilalɛlɛlɛlɛ, toyaleke la bootaota ebotosung’iso ndoomalesa Mungu la lisemoli la lilitesi la bɔwa;
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

lokele: eoka Mungu wasu ende bösä wa liambilo.
english: for our God is a consuming fire. Deuteronomy 4:24

lokele: Beoto ya Etanda, samakanaka la bɔkɔkɔmu;
english: Let brotherly love continue.

lokele: angolenja ndokeela bɛɛnda imɔ booto, eoka ongoma bamɔi basonyangela bakitomo angɛnɛ ani batilembeel’iyo!
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

lokele: Enyakelaka ebasokandakomo bɔnyɔlɔlɔ kwa mbo bosokandomo imɔ amamwito lau; imɔ ko ebasokeelomo obe finɛ, bende imɔ la bindo kwa ino.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

lokele: Batotina baliteseke lisɔngɔni; ebasosɔngɔnɔ angoingala la wasi eoka Mungu nd’atofak’eba nyongo la bolëfë se.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

lokele: Botema botumëke la yɛmɛ ya bieto; omala ko la yao ebisosɛlɛ ino, eoka Mungu angɛnɛ nd’aongaka mbo— Iitota aɛ se; iitomacha aɛ booi.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” Deuteronomy 31:6

lokele: Eokao tosoonga la lotendela mbo— Mungu nd’ale Bosungi wami, itiangowanga. ¿Balomboki angɛnɛ batokɔkɔlɔ ndokeela’mi iye?
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?” Psalms 118:6-7

lokele: Enyelaka ebayalaka Betoli oso yanu, ebaongelak’ino Lioi lia Mungu. Asoenyakel’ino boyaeli wa bawelo bau, tutelaka lilendelu liau.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

lokele: Yesu Masiya ale lɛlɛngɔ la louse la konda layalaya ngo ko boyaeli ɔmɔi.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

lokele: Oeyaeyesomoko ko la liekesi lia kanda la kanda la elia bɔfɔnɔ ebotiluwane lasu, eoka bolau mbo botema bokɔkɔmɛsɔmɔkɔ ko la booto wa Mungu, inga la yeka yola ebiitosungaka ebatotutaka boyaeli wa yao.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

lokele: Ebatokuwela etambelo ya Kumbo Eüchomo bati l’isosha sholaka eyele nda eyasu etambelo;
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

lokele: eoka akɛsɛkɛ Kanga-Eyeti bakila ba nyama nda Eüchelo ya Botanu kwa litambi eoka ya bobe, belyo ya nyama angɛnɛ yafechomoko lousa loa likula lia okenge.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. Leviticus 16:27

lokele: Ko ongoma to, Yesu awaka biale omolo lousa loa likula lia bokenge (wa Yelusaleme) mbo ataneseke bato batotina ko la bakila bande angɛnɛ.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

lokele: Kwani tümeke to lousa loa likula okawatemaka lande nda sɔni eyokak’inde,
english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

lokele: eoka toti la bokenge wokɔkɔmɔ eyamaya, nde tosokaluke ebokayeke.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

lokele: Ko la Inde ako Yesu, totambeke lifaefi lia liineli ende Mungu ko mbile bitotina, liko eula ya bɛnɔkɔ yasu ebitoaolela lina liande.
english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God Psalms 50:23 continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

lokele: Olenjëke to ndokeelana bolau la ndosungakana la bakaɔ, eoka ongoma bile batambi boomalesa Mungu finɛ.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

lokele: Litesaka betoli oso yanu la kuliaka likomyi liau la liikami se, eoka batolamba la belimo yanu la löwa la ocho kwa bato ebatokasanoela lotimbana loau mbo batimbaneke nda likuwa ko la bootaota, inga la bokikimeli, eoka wao angosung’ino ango sinyo.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

lokele: Somboelak’iso eoka toluwi nde mbo betema yasu biti la loasɔ, kongo ko tolɛmbi ndoyalaka la liengani nda njasɔ bitotina.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

lokele: Nde isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino finɛ mbo osomboeleke’mi mbo yeinolomoko end’ino lisasaya. Lisomboli la baseeli ba liko lia lokasa
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

lokele: Kwani Mungu wa lilatemi, Oyatɛmɔlɔkɔ Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu nda liwa, oyale Botingani woeta wa bɛkɔkɔ, ko la bakila ebatinyak’Inde la Ngɛla ya layalaya,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

lokele: aɔlɛsɛk’ino bitotina bilau yokelaka lisangi liande, ani Inde atokela end’ino yao ebitoomales’Inde angɛnɛ, ko la Yesu Masiya; la tala bitotina bifomoko end’Inde ko layalaya! Ongoma.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Nde isoomb’ino, Bitungani, ndoka lioi lia liɛngɔ lia lokasa loami, eoka isosɔnɛl’ino ko baoi bamyɔ.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

lokele: Luwaka to mbo etungani yasu ako Timoteo asotomo se, la eya nde lono sumbu lisasaya, iso lande koyɛn’ino.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

lokele: Seekelaka betoli oso yanu betotina la batotina ebüchomu ende Masiya. Eba yese ya Italia basoseekel’ino.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

lokele: Booto wa Munga boyaleke lanu yaatotina! Ongoma.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.
